t: Robust Magnusson straight tin snips designed for efficient and precise cutting work on various materials, including sheet metal. The durable manual 250mm tin snips are ideal for plumbers, roofers, and general fabricators needing reliable straight cuts. The blades are crafted from hard-wearing chrome vanadium steel, which is drop-forged and heat-treated for enhanced strength and longevity. A comfortable bi-material soft-grip handle ensures secure handling and reduced fatigue during prolonged use, and a spring-loaded action (with safety lock) makes light work of demanding cutting tasks.
b: Drop-Forged & Heat-Treated Chrome Vanadium Steel Blades
